title: MakeHuman / MPFB as a controlled perspective-reference generator
plainLanguage: MakeHuman/MPFB is useful because we can hold one body and one pose steady while changing the camera or a selected set of bones. That lets us make clean perspective teaching examples instead of relying only on random images.
purpose: Define the narrow, safe role of MakeHuman/MPFB in the Corpus Pane ecosystem.

rules.statement: Use a reference body approximating the gray mannequin only for controlled reference generation; do not make it the canonical mannequin.
Use partial poses to isolate arm, leg, head, or torso changes where useful.
Store generated images/landmarks as external_reference until mannequin-specific review.
Keep MPFB/MakeHuman software code licensing separate; this knowledge package does not copy their code.

implementation.futureWork: Create a bounded reference pack only after explicit approval.
